d: Welcome to Ghatshila! Join me on a culinary adventure as I track down and try the AMAZING Ghugni Street Food—a true Bengali delicacy! This dish, made from dried yellow peas, is a beloved favorite across the region, and I found the best local spot to sample it. Watch my honest experience and see why this authentic street food is something you MUST EAT when you visit. The flavor, the spices, the atmosphere—it was unforgettable!
